claims_scope: Exploratory construction of an unreviewed ontology or equivalent executable rule representation from explicitly synthetic policy materials; no real business or human-time conclusions.

arms.A_full_iterative: Goal, all competency questions, all allowed family material from the first call, complete source index, same validator feedback and opportunities to revise.
arms.B_goal_incremental: Same goal, competency questions and source index. Select material batches based on current questions; all the same family material remains available. Source selection consumes calls/tokens when a model call is used. Same validator feedback and opportunities to revise.

randomization.arm_order: alternating from a seeded shuffle, recorded before model execution

resource_caps_per_arm_family_repeat.note: These are ceilings, not equalized observed use. Do not invent token usage. Any backend without enforceable usage/cost limits is not ready under this contract.

run_gate: Choose an authorized no-new-cost execution backend and a recorded model identifier/snapshot; do not silently use a paid API.
Freeze model settings, actual usage capture and deterministic or disclosed stochastic replay rules before runs.
Resolve runnable output representation and interpreter before opening test predictions. Free-form prose cannot be evaluated by pretending to execute it.

Model construction workers receive only exported model-facing materials and permitted development examples. They must never receive evaluator labels, hidden case inputs, reference implementation, or other arms' outputs.
Freeze final ontology/rule artifact and raw model output before a separate evaluation process opens the target hidden cases.
Never tune/retry a frozen model on test-label feedback. Corrections require a new experimental version and fresh test families for confirmatory use.
feedback: Schema/syntax and pre-authorized development checks only; no test labels or test-derived corrections; automated feedback is never described as human review.
temporal_fairness: Both arms receive the same as-of evidence. Final future evidence is not supplied early to either arm. Policy-family material is static in this first construction pilot; transaction decision time is part of evaluator-only input.
reporting: Report every allocated run, including missing outputs, budget exhaustion, parser failure and unexecuted tasks.
Primary diagnostic outcomes: unsafe close count/rate among negatives, close recall among positives, three-state correctness, completion, per-family results.
Separate literal source locator existence from semantic support verified by an independent reviewer.
Report actual calls, input/output tokens, wall time, raw output/artifact hashes, and automated validation attempts. Unknown measurements remain null.
Human review time and time savings are not estimable in this stage.
Do not treat 60 authored cases as 60 independent business samples. There are six deliberately authored families, with only three in test.
No superiority, safety, or population significance claim from engineering probes or this small synthetic pilot.
